completeRightSide: Complete the right-hand side of the identity.
checkEquality: Enter values and check that the left-hand and right-hand sides are equal.
geometricExplanation: The diagram shows how (a+b)² splits into a² + 2ab + b².
activity1Objective: Complete the terms of the identity (a+b)² = a² + 2ab + b².
activity1Geometric: A square with side a+b, divided into areas a², b², and two equal rectangles ab.
activity2Objective: Complete the terms of the identity (a-b)² = a² - 2ab + b².
activity2Geometric: Start with a² and subtract two rectangles ab. Then add b² to correct for the double subtraction.
activity3Objective: Complete the terms of the identity (a+b)(a-b) = a² - b².
activity3Geometric: The area of the rectangle (a+b)(a-b) equals the difference between the squares a² and b².
activity4Objective: Choose values for a and b to see a numerical verification of the geometric proofs.
activity4Geometric: A numerical check of the identities using areas for specific values of a and b.
